thread:
alex: FYI escalated from Acme — embeddings endpoint returning intermittent 5xxs and long tails since ~10:30 PST. They report lots of single-item requests (~QPS 120) and occasional errors: "dimension mismatch: expected 1536, got 1024". p95 usually ~120ms but spikes to 2.0–2.5s. Logs pasted below.

maya: can you paste the request headers + model param? hosted or dedicated?

alex: Hosted API, model param: open-embedding-1536. Headers show X-Client-Version: 2.1.2 in some requests and 1.9.7 in others (weird). Sample logs: 
```
2026-03-16T17:31:02Z ERROR batch_coalescer: payload=[...], dims=1024 vs expected=1536, shard=us-east-1-a
2026-03-16T17:31:04Z WARN dynbatch: flush timeout reached (timeout_ms=15) with 1 item, batch_size=1
2026-03-16T17:31:04Z INFO serve: route fallback to open-embedding-1024 for request id=abc123
```

devin: my hunch — mixed client versions are hitting the same pool. Some clients call open-embedding-1024, others 1536. We have a bug where the batcher delays dim validation until kernel selection, so a mixed-dim batch can make it through coalescing and then fails during kernel select -> expensive failure path and tail spike.

luis: also note the flush timeout is tiny (15ms) so we get many single-item batches; that increases scheduling noise and tail latency. For a high-QPS single-item workload I'd bump timeout_ms to 30–50ms and lower max_batch_size to 32 to reduce contention.

maya: can we reproduce locally? devin, please run the repro harness with a traffic mix (70% 1536 / 30% 1024), single-item pacing, qps ~150 for 10m, and capture batch composition. Use this quick script:
```
# repro harness (pseudo)
for i in range(10000):
  model = "open-embedding-1536" if random() < 0.7 else "open-embedding-1024"
  client.embed(text=f"txt {i}", model=model)
  sleep(0.006)
```

devin: running on staging now — posting progress. preliminary: lots of 1–2 item batches, and I capture a few failed coalesces with "vector-dim-conflict". Example batch trace:
```
batch_id=bnk-42 items=[m1:1536,m2:1024] -> kernel_select ERROR -> fallback per-request kernel -> latency 2100ms
```

ops-bot: ticket #INC-4221 created and assigned to oncall-sre.

oncall-sre: I'll take this. Initial plan: 
- hotfix: validate vector dim at ingress and reject mismatched model requests with 400 (fast fail) — roll within 15m.
- config tweak: increase dynbatch timeout to 40ms for affected pool, reduce max_batch_size to 32 to smooth tails.
- mid-term: enforce pool-per-dimension routing or strong dim-based hashing so mixed dims never land on same batcher.

alex: client-side mitigation: ask Acme to upgrade to client >=2.1.3 which normalizes model param. I'll send repro steps and a short workaround: pin model version or set per-tenant header to avoid mixed-model routing.

maya: add metric alarm for batch_dim_mismatch_count and p99 latency on the embedding route. Also add dashboard for real-time batch size distribution.

devin: there's an open PR that fixes the delayed-dim-check in the batcher (https://git.redwood/embedding-batcher/pull/789). If hotfix is accepted, we can cherry-pick the PR.

oncall-sre: OK — will apply ingress dim validation + batching config changes now. ETA ~45m, will monitor metrics. If stable, will cherry-pick PR to prod-stable.

alex: thanks — ping me when done and I'll update Acme with repro + mitigation.

maya: :thumbsup:
